Container.Name: ArrayDeck
Container.Overview: ArrayDeck lists every Docker container on your Unraid server and derives the best available front-end URL automatically from Docker labels, dockerMan templates, reverse-proxy labels and safe HTTP probes. No per-application setup: containers are discovered, links are resolved, groups are inferred, and every decision has an inspectable trace. Read-only by design.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Read-only Docker socket for container list/inspect/events. For hardened deployments remove this and set DOCKER_HOST to a socket proxy instead.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite database with settings, overrides, icon cache and discovery decisions.

Config.Name: dockerMan templates
Config.Description: Unraid user templates, parsed read-only for WebUI patterns, icons and categories. The flash device is never written.

Config.Name: Unraid API URL
Config.Description: Optional: the Unraid GraphQL endpoint, e.g. http://tower.local/graphql. Enables hostname/LAN detection and server info.

Config.Name: Unraid API key
Config.Description: Optional: a READ-ONLY Unraid API key. Never exposed to the browser.

Config.Name: Reconcile interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Full re-discovery interval; Docker events update the UI within ~2 seconds regardless.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn or error (JSON logs).
